targets.old_statement: Yellow warns of hazards on a diamond, while orange warns of road work on a diamond or rectangle.
targets.statement: Yellow warns of hazardous or dangerous conditions and almost always appears on a diamond-shaped sign, while orange warns of road work on rectangular or diamond-shaped signs.

correction.corrected_statement: Yellow indicates a warning of hazardous or dangerous conditions and almost always appears on a diamond shaped sign, while orange indicates a warning concerning road work and appears on rectangular or diamond shaped signs.
correction.note: Added almost always qualifier for yellow diamond shape.

targets.old_statement: A pass with care sign ends a no-passing zone, while a do not pass sign begins one.
targets.statement: A rectangular Do Not Pass sign marks locations on two-lane or three-lane roads where passing is forbidden, while a yellow and black pennant-shaped No Passing Zone sign on the left side of the road points to the start of a no-passing zone.

correction.corrected_statement: Do not pass signs indicate locations where you must not pass on two or three lane roads, while the yellow and black pennant on the left side of the road points to the beginning of the no passing zone.
correction.note: Corrected beginning of zone to pennant sign, not do not pass sign.

targets.old_statement: An exclusion sign uses a red circle, with or without a diagonal slash, to prohibit a movement or activity, while other regulatory signs use black or red lettering on white to state restrictions in words.
targets.statement: An exclusion sign uses a red circle, with or without a diagonal slash, to prohibit a movement or activity, while other regulatory signs use black or red lettering on white to state restrictions in words.

correction.corrected_statement: An exclusion sign uses a red circle, with or without a diagonal slash, to prohibit a movement or activity, while other regulatory signs use black or red lettering on white to state restrictions in words.
correction.note: Second clause about other regulatory signs is on page 47 not page 46.

targets.old_statement: Guide and information signs in green, blue or brown locate places and services, while warning signs in yellow describe hazards.
